title: Visa TAP failure: validity window too long or expired
summary: The signature window is checked before the key and the signature. A window over 8 minutes, a created time in the future or an expires time in the past blocks the request. The specification's own example uses a 3,600-second window and would fail this check.

steps.label: Signed GET with a 60-minute window
steps.detail: created and expires are 3,600 seconds apart, as in the specification example.

payload.content:
GET /example-product HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example
Signature-Input: sig2=("@authority" "@path");created=1767225600;keyid="agent-key-1";alg="Ed25519";expires=1767229200;nonce="bm9uY2UtcGxhY2Vob2xkZXI";tag="agent-browser-auth"
Signature: sig2=:c2lnbmF0dXJlLXBsYWNlaG9sZGVy:

steps.label: Check created and expires
steps.detail: expires minus created must be at most 480 seconds; created must be past and expires future.

failures.condition: created in the future or expires in the past

steps.label: Block
steps.detail: The request is blocked before any key fetch; the agent must sign a fresh request.
